proposed_from.topic: Minimax Environment-Distance Theorem for corruption-robust BACKSHIFT. Observe m covariance slots, with an honest design H of size h=m-c satisfying Sigma_e=D^{-1}(Omega+diag(s_e))D^{-T}; D has the standard BACKSHIFT normalization and stability rule, Omega is invariant PSD and may be nondiagonal, and s_e>=0. The other c slots are arbitrary PSD. Define delta_H=min_{k<l}[h-max_L #{e in H:(s_ek,s_el) lies on affine line L}]. Prove that delta_H>c guarantees uniqueness for every c-slot contamination, and prove the matching minimax converse by a positive-definite ambiguity witness on the invariant-noise interior. Derive the exact generic maximum-collinearity formula and the exact sparse-support deletion threshold. Define the set-theoretic subset-consensus recovery map and confidence union over arbitrary nonempty positive-definite covariance regions, and prove the QE-free simultaneous-coverage implication. Under explicit declarative affine-separation, normalization-slack, covariance-interiority, conditioning, and scale bounds on every feasible candidate, prove only a non-effective compactness-based existence of a positive local radius and linear contraction if this analytic statement remains sound. Treat executable real quantifier elimination, exact generated semialgebraic union codes, terminating release/abstain decisions, rational empty/singleton/multiple classification, an effectively computed radius, normalization-chart automation, and a corruption-aware CRAN implementation as one unresolved open-ended future program; no such executable or effective interface is claimed here.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: RothenhauslerEtAl2015BackShift, Theorem 1, is recovered at \(c=0\), but it assumes every covariance slot belongs to one honest shift family. AkhavanEtAl2019GeometryJD, Section 4.2, informs the robust-joint-diagonalization setting by trimming matrices with a tuning threshold, without an exact replacement radius or a necessity construction. The field-tier contribution is the minimax quantifier and overlap loss: uniqueness must hold for every choice of \(c\) arbitrary positive-definite slots even though an alternative explanation may discard a different \(c\)-subset. The matching converse must extend an affine-degenerate overlap to observed positive-definite slots satisfying two distinct raw BACKSHIFT explanations, with unit diagonal, the cycle-product normalization, an interior invariant nuisance, and nonnegative shifts.

seed_details.seed: Exact adversarial environment-replacement radius for population BACKSHIFT.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; population covariance equation (5); Theorem 1; Corollary 1; Appendix proof of Theorem 1; Conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the original proof's common full family by the intersection of two candidate honest subsets, whose guaranteed size is only \(m-2c\), and then convert affine degeneracy on that overlap into a legal second raw-covariance model.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for BACKSHIFT with corrupted environments, adversarial covariance slots, robust joint diagonalization, and maximum-consensus simultaneous diagonalization found only threshold trimming in AkhavanEtAl2020GeometryJD, Section 4.2.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from RothenhauslerEtAl2015BackShift because deleting the bad environments leaves an ordinary joint-diagonalization problem.
seed_details.rebuttal: The honest subset is unknown and competing explanations may delete different slots, so only \(m-2c\) common slots remain; necessity additionally requires manufacturing arbitrary positive-definite replacement slots that validate a second normalized stable BACKSHIFT model with nonnegative shifts.

seed_details.seed: Exact generic affine-occupancy formula and sparse-support robustness threshold.
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1 and Corollary 1(ii), where fully continuous intervention variances yield almost-sure noncollinearity.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain prescribed structural zeros and classify every affine incidence forced by the support states \(00,10,01,11\) before excluding all remaining collinearities as nonzero-polynomial events.
seed_details.destination_search: PerryVonKugelgenScholkopf2022SparseShift, Section 4, and PfisterPeters2022SparseIV, Theorem 3, connect sparse change placement to identification but do not compute BACKSHIFT affine occupancy under replacement.
seed_details.red_team: A routine genericity corollary, because independently continuous nonzero amplitudes rule out accidental lines automatically.
seed_details.rebuttal: Structural zeros force repeated origins and axis lines; the exact maximum is the four-term formula in \(M_{k\ell}^{\mathrm{gen}}\), not the dimension count or the fully continuous corollary.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Theorem 7; Algorithm 5; Conclusion and discussion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Move the complete-family positive-definite congruence-feasibility test inside an enumeration of candidate honest subsets, then impose BACKSHIFT normalization, common raw covariance, and nonnegative shifts.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for maximum-consensus congruence diagonalization found maximum-consensus robust fitting for linear incidence and the heuristic outlier update of AkhavanEtAl2020GeometryJD, but no complete causal candidate enumeration.
seed_details.red_team: Brute-force subset enumeration is immediate and contributes no mathematics beyond LeNguyen2022HermitianSDC.
seed_details.rebuttal: Completeness is baseline-sensitive, and the returned objects must satisfy causal normalization plus raw positive-definite and nonnegative-shift feasibility; the algorithm is valuable as the computational realization of the new exact radius rather than as a complexity claim.

seed_details.red_team: Once the generic occupancy formula is known, support design is a routine finite combinatorial optimization.
seed_details.rebuttal: A coding-theoretic optimum with matching lower bound could be substantive, but no such certificate is presently derived.
seed_details.drop_reason: Reserved as a downstream corollary program rather than the first version's theorem kernel.

proposed_from.literature_map: The central chain is RothenhauslerEtAl2015BackShift, Theorem 1 and its appendix two-row deformation, followed by KleinsteuberShen2013NUJDUniqueness, Theorem 1, for complete-family uniqueness up to scaling and permutation. The closest outlier paper located is AkhavanEtAl2020GeometryJD, Section 4.2 and equation (42), which iteratively trims target matrices by a user-chosen residual threshold and reports simulations rather than an adversarial identification theorem. LeNguyen2022HermitianSDC, Theorem 7 and Algorithm 5, decides congruence diagonalizability of one complete Hermitian family through positive-definite feasibility and commuting transforms. PerryVonKugelgenScholkopf2022SparseShift, Section 4 and Theorem 4.4, and PfisterPeters2022SparseIV, Theorem 3, establish that change placement can control generic causal identification, but neither computes affine incidence for sparse BACKSHIFT shifts. Afsari2008JDSensitivity supplies the conditioning and uniqueness-modulus perturbation template. AndrewsCheng2013SporadicID supplies the identification-robust confidence-set arc. Targeted searches through September 3, 2026 found no paper combining arbitrary positive-definite environment replacement, a necessary-and-sufficient BACKSHIFT radius, a matching causal contamination construction, and subset-uniform inference.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:sharp-replacement-radius / ass:invariant-noise-interior
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The legal alternative-model construction and quantitative conditioning are conditional on an interior invariant covariance Ω ∈ S++p, rather than the full PSD nuisance class allowed by ordinary BACKSHIFT.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact replacement radius on the stated interior-noise class; no unrestricted PSD-boundary converse is claimed.
